name: PDH break

story.template: {symbol} above PDH {line:,.2f} at {at} · watching for the fade

note: Stage 1 of the PD fade (design 1 Nov 2026): a silent heads-up when a 5m bar first closes above yesterday's high (continuous, so a gap open counts on the 09:15 bar's close). No trade block: never graded, never queued, no desk verdict; side short is for the chip colour only. One per stock per day (cooldown 400 min). Observed over 20 sessions (1-30 Oct 2026, 213 stocks): a close above PDH came back to touch PDH 87 % of the time and closed back below it 80 %. The trade is PDH fade: all day 20 fires/day, 59 % target first, median R:R 1:0.9, +0.10 R per trade.
